explication: Datadog Test Optimization for Ruby instruments test frameworks, enriches test execution with CI and repository context, and reports test visibility data while applying optimization policies. The principal workflow starts when a test runner is instrumented, then records test spans and coverage, consults remote settings, and supports retries or test-impact selection before sending data. The README documents these capabilities; the supplied source excerpts show integration registration, Git operations, and settings requests, but not most runtime component wiring, so several capability links are marked unverified.
